utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, heard you were organizing a repair drive—how's that going?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It's coming along. I've set up a schedule for volunteers and collected a list of common items to repair.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's great! Do you need any help spreading the word or gathering supplies?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, we're collecting donations to fix the community center roof.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, that sounds important. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this repair drive is going to work?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don't know, Kira—we don't even have the right screws for the casing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you're saying it's hopeless? Maybe we should call a professional.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I think I was supposed to bring some tools... or was it snacks?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We're short on tools, actually. Snacks are covered, so tools would be great.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Tools, right, tools. I've got a bunch in my shed, I think. Let me go check and bring what I can find.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, the repair drive? What exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, I think it's something about the main water line? Or was it the electrical box? I can't quite remember.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let's double-check the maintenance log; I think we noted something about the pump last week.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I'm late. What's going on with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, hey Dane! No worries. I was just about to ask you the same thing – I heard we're collecting tools for the community repair day?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yes, that's right! Everyone's supposed to bring any spare tools they have to the garage on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Need a hand with that repair drive? I've got some tools in my garage if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam! I might just take you up on that. What kind of tools do you have?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've got a set of screwdrivers, pliers, and a multimeter. Should cover most basics.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: So, Faye, where exactly is this repair drive taking place? I like to keep track of these things.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's at the community center on Maple Street, right next to the school.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Ah, right next to the school. I'll mark that down. Thanks, Faye.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I heard they're collecting old electronics and appliances.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh yes, I was just about to put up flyers! Want to help me spread the word? The more people we get, the better!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, count me in! I can take a stack of flyers to the community center and the coffee shop down the street.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you finish fixing the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm sorry, I haven't had a chance to look at it yet. What needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The drive won't mount. Could you take a look at it tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Nell, I heard there's a repair drive happening. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think it's a community event where we help each other fix broken stuff. I heard about it from the group chat.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, so it's a community fix-it event? I'll have to tell the others on my block about it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, thanks for coming by! I was hoping to chat with you about the upcoming repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, the repair drive... Yes, I heard about it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I'm glad you're here! Do you have any skills or tools you could contribute? We could really use a hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Eli, have you heard about the repair drive they're organizing over at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I heard a little about it. But I'd like to know more—what exactly are they planning to repair, and when?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They're fixing up old electronics and small appliances, and it's happening this Saturday from 10 to 4. I'm thinking of bringing my toaster!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I'm late. How's the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's going pretty well! I was just telling Maria that we're meeting at the community center at 10 tomorrow to start fixing up the old playground.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, 10 works for me. I'll bring some tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Uli, I heard we're organizing a repair drive. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's a community effort to fix things around here.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, that sounds like a good way to bring people together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Opal, what's this about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is happening at the community center this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM. I have a list of volunteers if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, sounds good. Send me that list later.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana! I heard you're organizing the repair drive—how's it going so far?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It's going well so far! I'm just double-checking the list of needed supplies—do you have any tools to donate?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I think I have a spare hammer and some screwdrivers in the garage—let me check and I'll bring them by later!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I forgot about that. What's going on?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's the neighborhood repair drive this weekend—we're fixing up the old playground equipment at the park. Can we count on you to help out?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, yeah, I think I can make it. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, how's the repair drive going? Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I'm fixing up some old lawnmowers. If you can lend a hand with the spark plugs, that'd be great.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Happy to help with the spark plugs. I'll grab my tools and be right over.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, how's the repair drive going? Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I could use a hand with the old truck's engine. Tools are in the shed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, let's head to the shed and grab the tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Have we figured out who's bringing the tools? I'd hate for us to be missing something important.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I'll ask around, but do you have a list of what we need?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I have a list here: screwdrivers, a hammer, measuring tape, and a level.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? I think it's a great chance to get together and fix things up!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I sure have! I've been checking our supply stash to see what we'll need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome! We should rally some more folks to join—the more hands, the merrier!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Oren, I heard we're organizing a repair drive for the school. How can I help coordinate the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, a repair drive! Yes, I remember something about that... maybe we should ask the school office for the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Good idea, I'll head to the office tomorrow morning and find out the details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell, I'm glad you could stop by! I wanted to chat about the upcoming repair drive—do you have a moment to help coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, sure, I can help a bit, but I don't know much about it—what's a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It's a community event where we fix broken household items together—like clothes, small appliances, or furniture—to reduce waste and help neighbors out.
